images.title: 65 squared in four pieces
images.purpose: Shows the square of side 65 split into a 60 square, a 5 square and two 60 by 5 rectangles, adding to 4225.
images.composition: One large square centred, split into four parts by one vertical and one horizontal line. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A large square split at 60 out of 65 along both sides. Top left: a teal (#0072B2) 60 by 60 square labelled '3600'. Top right: an amber (#E69F00) strip 5 wide and 60 tall. Bottom left: an amber strip 60 wide and 5 tall. Each amber strip carries the label '300' placed just outside it with a short leader line. Bottom right: a small reddish purple (#CC79A7) 5 by 5 square labelled '25' with a short leader line. Along the top edge, the labels '60' and '5' over the two parts. Below the square, centred, the label '65² = 4225'. Exactly 4 parts.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.description: Shows the square of side 65 split into a 60 square, a 5 square and two 60 by 5 rectangles, adding to 4225.

image_decisions.why: The two rectangles are what students forget; the split square shows all four pieces.
